### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/metadata`, `@objectstack/objectql`, touching **10** documentable anchor(s).

**8** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`  _(via MetadataPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/api/index.mdx`  _(via MetadataPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`  _(via MetadataPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`  _(via MetadataManager (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx`  _(via MetadataManager (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/kernel/services-checklist.mdx`  _(via MetadataPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/plugins/adding-a-metadata-type.mdx`  _(via MetadataManager (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/metadata-service.mdx`  _(via MetadataManager (symbol, a top-level class), MetadataPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/implementation-status.mdx`  _(via MetadataManager (symbol, a top-level class), MetadataPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via MetadataManager (symbol, a top-level class))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **11** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **32** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json cac0f1aab6e729e7526c166bb8d3f76219afd4a3` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `e1c6346febc6e90b880941b6d5eb87a6c168a2ca` — the merge of head `b56b80402e1fd05124dd661c8ccd9527f7b8ef2d` into base `cac0f1aab6e729e7526c166bb8d3f76219afd4a3`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin e1c6346febc6e90b880941b6d5eb87a6c168a2ca && git checkout e1c6346febc6e90b880941b6d5eb87a6c168a2ca
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin cac0f1aab6e729e7526c166bb8d3f76219afd4a3 b56b80402e1fd05124dd661c8ccd9527f7b8ef2d && git checkout -B drift-repro cac0f1aab6e729e7526c166bb8d3f76219afd4a3 && git merge --no-ff b56b80402e1fd05124dd661c8ccd9527f7b8ef2d

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json cac0f1aab6e729e7526c166bb8d3f76219afd4a3
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs cac0f1aab6e729e7526c166bb8d3f76219afd4a3` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · 2026-11-12T13:02Z

Head-sha: `cee5a236250de960850a281966262cd7bd4b7717`

- **Shape:** draft → `main`. First line `Fixes #32154`, the only closing keyword in the body. `Clause-②: yes` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are line-initial in the body (seat-corrected) and in the changeset (`cee5a236`). They match claim amendment 6824117476.
- **Declaration review (`TIER_DEFAULT`, lane seat's record):** the widening is `MetadataManagerOptions.awaitHostLogger` + `MetadataManager.useHostLogger(logger)` on `@objectstack/metadata`'s exported entry. Both are additive: a manager built without the option logs exactly as before (pinned in `metadata-manager-host-logger.test.ts`). No accept set narrows, and no `packages/spec/src/**` file or governed path is in the diff, so no contract-tier record is owed. The `patch` level is right for a non-protocol widening.
- **Scope:** 12 files, all in the claim's surface as amended by 6817810585 (`plugin.ts`, logger handoff only). `engine-top-level.ts` is used for the one-line shape helper, as the claim allowed.
- **Rulings read against the diff:**
  - Decision D (6792381695): `callerInputRefusalLogMeta` answers only for an engine `ValidationError` that is not a `NotNullRefusalError`. It produces one `warn` line with no stack, holding `{ object, operation, fields: [{ field, code }], reason }` and never the refused values. Every other failure falls through to `writeFailureLogMeta` with its stack. **Holds.**
  - Item 1: `resolveDriverClientName` reads `knex.client.dialect` last, only when no name was found. driver-sql's fault log is untouched. **Holds.**
  - Item 3, option B: the plugin sets `awaitHostLogger` and calls `useHostLogger(ctx.logger)` first in `init()`. **Holds.**
- **Owed and present:** the WHOLE dogfood battery on `9961667786` (454 files passed / 3 skipped; 3810 tests passed / 42 skipped; lock VERDICT 0). `cee5a236` adds only one changeset line on top of it, so that battery stands.
- **Pins and ablations:** four ablations, each red then restored: the dialect read, the insert-door meta, `awaitHostLogger`, and the `useHostLogger` call. 72 derived gates exit 0; `pnpm lint` 0.
- **Accepted deviations:** the seat's own late `Clause-②` correction, and three `main` merges (merge commits, no rebase).
- **Landing:** non-governed paths, 620 changed lines. Lands on green check-runs at this head after the base-drift check: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.
